lastSummary: NC-041 fixed: Token estimation and context compression are too approximate. (1) TokenCounter: DEFAULT_CHARS_PER_TOKEN changed from 4.0 to 3.8 (more accurate for mixed code/prose). Added recordProviderUsage() with EMA calibration (alpha=0.3, min 5 samples to trust). Added setCharsPerToken() for model-specific ratios from ModelCapabilityRegistry. Added trackRequestWithUsage() that uses real provider-reported token counts AND calibrates the estimation ratio. Added isCalibrated(), getCharsPerToken(), getCalibrationSampleCount(). Reset clears calibration state. getStats() now includes charsPerToken and calibrationSamples. (2) ProviderUsage interface added to types.ts with promptTokens/completionTokens/totalTokens. ModelResponse.usage field added (optional for backward compat). (3) OpenAICompatibleProvider: extracts usage from OpenAI API responses (prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/total_tokens). (4) OllamaProvider: extracts usage from Ollama API responses (prompt_eval_count/eval_count). (5) ModelCapabilityRegistry: added charsPerToken to all 40+ static entries (Qwen=3.5, DeepSeek=3.7, Llama=3.8, GPT=4.0, Claude=3.8). Added getCharsPerToken(provider, model) method. (6) ModelCapabilities interface: added charsPerToken field. (7) Orchestrator: reads charsPerToken from registry and calls tokenCounter.setCharsPerToken() before generating. (8) ContextCompressor: fromContextWindow() factory creates compressor with proportional threshold (25% of context window * charsPerToken). Content-hash deduplication (SHA-256 with length+prefix fast pre-check) replaces first-100-chars prefix dedup. Configurable head/tail for file compression. (9) New agent-core/tests/tokenEstimation.test.ts: 44 tests covering TokenCounter calibration (default ratio, setCharsPerToken, EMA, trackRequestWithUsage, reset), ContextCompressor improvements (fromContextWindow, dedup, file compression), ModelCapabilityRegistry getCharsPerToken, ProviderUsage type. (10) Updated contextBudget.test.ts: fixed hardcoded /4 to use estimateTokens(). (11) Updated realModelSecurity.test.ts: fixed dedup test to reflect correct content-hash behavior (distinct contexts are no longer falsely deduplicated). 1911/1911 tests pass. Build clean. All type-checks clean.
